exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures of food and drinks. Which are: healthy, low-fat foods; fatty foods; junk food?
exercises.instructionUz: Ovqat va ichimliklar suratlariga qarang. Qaysilari: sog'lom, kam yog'li ovqatlar; yog'li ovqatlar; foydasiz ovqat?
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh TOIFA.


⚠ 'HEALTHY, LOW-FAT FOODS':

  = sog'lom, kam yog'li ovqatlar.
  Betdan: melon, cucumber,
  watermelon, mushrooms, peaches,
  carrot juice, apple juice,
  lettuce, fruit salad, green beans,
  peas, prawns, mussels, yoghurt
  (low fat), grilled chicken,
  wholemeal bread, broccoli


⚠ 'FATTY FOODS':

  = yog'li ovqatlar.
  Betdan: fried chicken, sausages,
  bacon, chocolate cake, doughnut,
  nuts, olive oil, French toast,
  garlic bread


⚠ 'JUNK FOOD':

  = foydasiz, tez tayyor ovqat.
  Betdan: club sandwich with chips,
  doughnut, bacon & cheese sandwich


⚠ 'FOOD' - SANALMAYDIGAN:

  ⚠ 'Food IS expensive.' (BIRLIK
  fe'l)
  ⚠ Lekin 'foods' = turli xil
  ovqatlar (turlar haqida
  gapirganda) - mashqda ham shunday.


⚠ 'JUNK':

  = axlat, keraksiz narsa.
  ⚠ 'junk food' - SANALMAYDIGAN,
  'junk foods' XATO.


⚠ 'FATTY' va 'FAT':

  fat = semiz (odam) yoki yog' (ot)
  fatty = yog'li (ovqat)

  ⚠ 'a fat food' - XATO,
  'a fatty food' ✓


⚠ 'LOW-FAT':

  ⚠ DEFIS bilan (sifat vazifasida).
  ⚠ Aksi: 'full-fat' yoki 'high-fat'.

exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ 'A VEGETARIAN':

  = go'sht yemaydigan odam.
  ⚠ Lekin tuxum, sut, pishloq yeydi.
  ⚠ 'a vegan' = umuman hayvon
  mahsulotlarini yemaydigan.


⚠ 'TO BE ON A DIET':

  = parhezda bo'lmoq (ozish uchun).
  ⚠ 'ON a diet' - 'on' predlogi
  ShART.
  ⚠ 'to go on a diet' = parhezga
  o'tirmoq.


⚠ 'A DIET' - IKKI MA'NO:

  1) parhez (ozish uchun)
  2) ovqatlanish tarzi (umuman)
     'a healthy diet' = sog'lom
     ovqatlanish

  ⚠ 3c mashqida IKKINChI ma'noda.


⚠ 'SUITABLE FOR':

  = ... uchun mos.
  ⚠ 'suitable TO' - XATO.
  ⚠ 'to suit' = mos kelmoq.

Are you a fussy eater? d) Which foods: contain a lot of calories; contain protein; are rich in vitamins?

Injiq yeguvchimisiz? d) Qaysi ovqatlarda: ko'p kaloriya bor; oqsil bor; vitaminlarga boy?
exercises.explanationUz:
SUHBAT SAVOLLARI.


⚠ 'AT WORK' va 'AT SCHOOL':

  ⚠ ARTIKLSIZ! Chunki MAQSAD ko'zda
  tutilyapti (ishlash, o'qish).
  ⚠ 37-38-betlarda 'at university'
  ham shunday edi.


⚠ 'ON A PICNIC':

  ⚠ 'on' predlogi - 38-betdagi
  23-mashqda ham bor edi.


⚠ 'A FAST-FOOD RESTAURANT':

  ⚠ DEFIS bilan (sifat vazifasida).
  ⚠ 'fast food' (ot) - defissiz.


⚠ 'AN EXPENSIVE RESTAURANT':

  ⚠ 'AN' - chunki 'expensive' UNLI
  bilan boshlanadi.


⚠ 'A SNACK BETWEEN MEALS':

  = ovqatlar orasida yengil tamaddi.
  ⚠ 'a meal' = ovqatlanish
  (nonushta, tushlik, kechki ovqat).
  ⚠ 36-betdagi 14-mashqda 'have a
  snack' bor edi.


⚠ 'A FUSSY EATER':

  = injiq yeguvchi (ko'p narsani
  yemaydigan).
  ⚠ 'fussy' = injiq, tanlab
  yeydigan.


⚠ 'TO CONTAIN':

  = o'z ichiga olmoq, tarkibida
  bo'lmoq.
  ⚠ 'to contain' - PREDLOGSIZ.


⚠ 'RICH IN':

  = ... ga boy.
  ⚠ 'rich IN vitamins' - 'in'
  predlogi ShART.
  ⚠ 'rich of' - XATO.


⚠ 'CALORIES', 'PROTEIN', 'VITAMINS':

  ⚠ 'a calorie' - SANALADIGAN.
  ⚠ 'protein' - SANALMAYDIGAN.
  ⚠ 'a vitamin' - SANALADIGAN.
  ⚠ 'vitamin' Britaniyada /ˈvɪtəmɪn/,
  AQShda /ˈvaɪtəmɪn/.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct preposition, then make sentences using the completed phrases.
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri predlogni qo'ying, so'ng tayyor iboralar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
PREDLOGLAR - HAMMASI MAQOLADA BOR.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

  ON film sets
     - kino maydonchalarida
  ON a diet
     - parhezda
  ninety-nine per cent OF the time
     - vaqtning 99 foizida
  to insist ON sth
     - qat'iy talab qilmoq
  to worry ABOUT sth
     - xavotir olmoq
  to cook FOR sb
     - kimgadir ovqat pishirmoq
  to complain ABOUT sth
     - shikoyat qilmoq
  to think ABOUT sth
     - o'ylamoq


⚠ 'ABOUT' - UCh FE'L BILAN:

  worry about, complain about,
  think about
  ⚠ Yana: 'wonder about' (5-mashq).


⚠ 'TO INSIST ON':

  ⚠ 'ON' + -ING yoki ot:
     'insist ON eating'
     'insist ON fresh juice'
  ⚠ 'insist TO' - XATO!


⚠ 'TO COOK FOR SB':

  ⚠ 'cook TO sb' - XATO.
  ⚠ Xuddi shunday: 'buy sth FOR sb',
  'make sth FOR sb'.


⚠ 'TO THINK ABOUT' va 'TO THINK OF':

  think about = o'ylab ko'rmoq
     (uzoq, chuqur)
  think of = eslamoq, tasavvur
     qilmoq

  ⚠ 'What do you THINK OF it?' =
  Bu haqda fikring qanday?


⚠ 'SB' va 'STH':

  sb = somebody (kimdir)
  sth = something (nimadir)
  ⚠ Lug'atlarda ishlatiladigan
  qisqartmalar.


⚠ 'PER CENT':

  ⚠ Britaniyada AJRATIB: 'per cent'.
  ⚠ AQShda QO'ShIB: 'percent'.
  ⚠ '99 per cent OF the time'.

tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'ON a film set' - 'on' predlogi.
⚠ Maqolada: 'Chefs and caterers ON FILM SETS'.

⚠ 'ON a diet' - 'on' predlogi ShART.
⚠ 'in a diet' - XATO.

⚠ 'per cent OF' - 'of' predlogi.
⚠ Britaniyada 'per cent' AJRATIB yoziladi.

⚠ 'to insist ON' + -ING yoki ot.
⚠ 'insist to' - XATO!

⚠ 'to worry ABOUT' - 'about' predlogi.
⚠ 'worry for' - XATO.

⚠ 'to cook FOR sb' - 'for' predlogi.
⚠ 'cook to sb' - XATO.

⚠ 'to complain ABOUT' - 'about' predlogi.
⚠ To'liq: 'complain TO sb ABOUT sth'.

⚠ 'to think ABOUT' + -ING.
⚠ 'think OF' = eslamoq, tasavvur qilmoq -
biroz boshqa ma'no.

exercises.explanationUz:
MA'NODOShLARNI ALMAShTIRISh.

RO'YXAT: constantly, fatty,
         wondered about, insists on


JAVOBLAR:

  1 asked yourself → WONDERED ABOUT
  2 continuously → CONSTANTLY
  3 demands → INSISTS ON
  4 fattening → FATTY


⚠ 3-BANDGA DIQQAT - ShAKL:

  'Dad always DEMANDS a cup of hot
   milk'
  → 'Dad always INSISTS ON a cup of
     hot milk'

  ⚠ 'demand' PREDLOGSIZ, lekin
  'insist' 'ON' bilan!
  ⚠ Shakl ham 3-shaxs birlik:
  'insistS'.


⚠ 'CONSTANTLY' va 'CONTINUOUSLY':

  constantly = doimo, tez-tez
     takrorlanib
  continuously = uzluksiz,
     to'xtovsiz

  ⚠ Bu yerda deyarli bir xil.


⚠ 'FATTY' va 'FATTENING':

  fatty = yog'li (tarkibida yog'
     ko'p)
  fattening = semirtiruvchi

  ⚠ Deyarli bir xil, lekin
  'fattening' NATIJAga urg'u beradi.


⚠ 'A DIETER':

  = parhezdagi odam.
  ⚠ 'diet' + '-er'.


⚠ 'DAMAGE':

  = zarar.
  ⚠ SANALMAYDIGAN!
  ⚠ 'to do damage TO sth' = zarar
  yetkazmoq.


⚠ 'SLIM':

  = nozik, xushbichim.
  ⚠ 'thin' dan ijobiyroq.
  ⚠ 'to stay slim' = nozik qolmoq.


⚠ 'BEDTIME':

  = uxlash vaqti.
  ⚠ QO'ShIB yoziladi.
  ⚠ 'before bedtime' - artiklsiz.

BESh PIShIRISh USULI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗

⚠ 'AN OVEN':

  ⚠ O'qilishi /ˈʌvən/ - 'a' EMAS!

⚠ QOIDA:

  Har qatorda BITTA so'z QALIN idish
  so'ziga MOS KELMAYDI - o'shani
  toping.


TO'LIQ JAVOBLAR:

  1 a bar of ... → BREAD ortiqcha
    ('a bar of chocolate/soap' ✓,
     'a LOAF of bread')
  2 a carton of ... → BACON ortiqcha
    ('a carton of juice/milk' ✓,
     'a RASHER of bacon')
  3 a slice of ... → BUTTER ortiqcha
    ('a slice of bread/ham/cake' ✓,
     'a PACKET of butter')
  4 a cup of ... → MEAT ortiqcha
    (piyolada faqat ichimlik)
  5 a bowl of ... → CAKE ortiqcha
    (kosada suyuq/donador ovqat)
  6 a glass of ... → CHEESE ortiqcha
    (stakanda faqat ichimlik)
  7 a bottle of ... → BEEF ortiqcha
    (shishada faqat suyuqlik)
  8 a jar of ... → POTATOES ortiqcha
    ('a jar of honey/jam/mustard' ✓,
     'a KILO of potatoes')
  9 a bag of ... → KETCHUP ortiqcha
    ('a bag of flour/sugar/crisps' ✓,
     'a BOTTLE of ketchup')
  10 a box of ... → VINEGAR ortiqcha
    ('a box of chocolates/biscuits' ✓,
     'a BOTTLE of vinegar')


⚠ 'A BAR':

  = plitka, bo'lak.
  ⚠ 'a bar of chocolate' = shokolad
  plitkasi.
  ⚠ 'a bar of soap' = sovun bo'lagi.


⚠ 'A CARTON':

  = karton quti (sut, sharbat uchun).


⚠ 'A SLICE':

  = tilim, bo'lak.
  ⚠ 'to slice' = tilimlamoq.


⚠ 'A JAR':

  = banka (shishali, keng og'izli).
  ⚠ 'a bottle' - tor bo'yinli shisha.


⚠ 'CEREAL':

  = donli nonushta (kornfleks).
  ⚠ SANALMAYDIGAN.
  ⚠ 'serial' (seriya) bilan BIR XIL
  o'qiladi!


⚠ 'CRISPS':

  = kartoshka chipsi (Britaniya).
  ⚠ AQShda 'chips'.
  ⚠ HAR DOIM ko'plikda.


⚠ 'FLOUR':

  = un.
  ⚠ 'flower' (gul) bilan BIR XIL
  o'qiladi: /flaʊə/!


⚠ 'MUSTARD':

  = xantal.
  ⚠ SANALMAYDIGAN.

⚠ 'FISH' va 'SEAFOOD' FARQI:

exercises.instructionEn: What Do The Stars Eat?
exercises.instructionUz: Yulduzlar nima yeydi?
exercises.explanationUz:
MAQOLANING TO'LIQ MATNI VA
TARJIMASI bandlarda berilgan.


⚠ MAQOLA HAQIDA:

  Ikki oshpaz-ta'minotchi (John Sharp
  va Susan Tate) kino yulduzlarining
  ovqatlanish odatlari haqida
  gapiradi.


⚠ QALIN SO'ZLAR - 5-MAShQDA
  TUShUNTIRILADI:

  dating, wondered about, chefs,
  caterers, film sets, eating habits,
  strict, constantly on a diet,
  insist on, filming, steamed,
  worry about, fixed, complain about,
  sits, snack


⚠ 'A STAR' bu yerda:

  = mashhur aktyor/aktrisa.


⚠ MAQOLADAGI ISMLAR:

  John Sharp - oshpaz (chef)
  Susan Tate - ta'minotchi (caterer)
  Demi Moore, Helen Hunt,
  Eddie Murphy, Whoopi Goldberg,
  Bill Murray, Mickey Rourke -
  kino yulduzlari
  Michelle Pfeiffer, Al Pacino -
  yana ikki yulduz

  ⚠ 'Now and Then' va 'Twister' -
  filmlar nomi (QIYa harflarda).

tasks.en: Film stars are everyone's favourite subject. People love to talk about what they're wearing, who they're dating, and how much money they make. But have you ever wondered about what they eat?
tasks.uz: Kino yulduzlari - hammaning sevimli mavzusi. Odamlar ular nima kiyayotgani, kim bilan uchrashayotgani va qancha pul ishlayotgani haqida gapirishni yaxshi ko'radi. Lekin ular nima yeydi deb hech o'ylab ko'rganmisiz?
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to date sb' = kim bilandir uchrashmoq
(sevishganlar).
⚠ 'to wonder about' = qiziqmoq, o'ylab ko'rmoq.
⚠ 'to make money' = pul ishlamoq.

tasks.en: Chefs and caterers on film sets have the answers. "Every actor has different eating habits," says chef John Sharp.
tasks.uz: Kino maydonchalaridagi oshpazlar va ta'minotchilarda javob bor. "Har bir aktyorning ovqatlanish odatlari har xil", - deydi oshpaz Jon Sharp.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'a chef' = professional oshpaz (/ʃef/).
⚠ 'a caterer' = ovqat bilan ta'minlovchi.
⚠ 'a film set' = kino suratga olish maydonchasi.

tasks.en: "Some stars love meat, while others are strict vegetarians who don't eat meat, eggs, or fish. Some stars love junk food, while others are constantly on a diet and eat only healthy foods."
tasks.uz: "Ba'zi yulduzlar go'shtni yaxshi ko'radi, boshqalari esa go'sht, tuxum va baliq yemaydigan qat'iy vegetarianlar. Ba'zi yulduzlar foydasiz ovqatni yaxshi ko'radi, boshqalari esa doim parhezda va faqat sog'lom ovqat yeydi".
tasks.note:
⚠ 'strict' = qat'iy.
⚠ 'constantly' = doimo.
⚠ 'while' bu yerda = holbuki, esa
(qarama-qarshilik).

tasks.en: Ninety-nine per cent of the time, actresses are on a diet and insist on eating only low-fat foods.
tasks.uz: Vaqtning to'qson to'qqiz foizida aktrisalar parhezda bo'lib, faqat kam yog'li ovqat yeyishni talab qiladi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'per cent OF the time' - 'of' predlogi.
⚠ 'to insist ON' + -ING.

tasks.en: During the filming of Now and Then, Demi Moore ate nothing but Basmati rice, steamed baby spinach, green beans with lemon, and turkey sandwiches on wholemeal bread.
tasks.uz: 'Now and Then' filmini suratga olish paytida Demi Mur faqat basmati guruch, bug'da pishirilgan yosh ismaloq, limonli yashil loviya va to'liq donli nondagi kurka sendvichlarini yedi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'nothing but' = faqat, boshqa hech narsa.
⚠ 'steamed' = bug'da pishirilgan.
⚠ 'a sandwich ON wholemeal bread' - 'on'
predlogi.

tasks.en: During the filming of Twister, Helen Hunt only ate low-calorie foods, including poached eggs, dry toast, and steamed brown rice with vegetables.
tasks.uz: 'Twister' filmini suratga olish paytida Helen Xant faqat kam kaloriyali ovqat yedi: suvda pishirilgan tuxum, quruq tost va sabzavotli bug'da pishirilgan jigarrang guruch.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'low-calorie' - DEFIS bilan.
⚠ 'dry toast' = sariyog'siz tost.
⚠ 'including' = ... jumladan.

tasks.en: Other stars love to eat junk food, and never count calories during their meals. Eddie Murphy's favourite food is Kentucky Fried Chicken.
tasks.uz: Boshqa yulduzlar foydasiz ovqat yeyishni yaxshi ko'radi va ovqat paytida hech qachon kaloriya sanamaydi. Eddi Merfining sevimli taomi - Kentucky Fried Chicken.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to count calories' = kaloriya sanamoq.
⚠ 'a meal' = ovqatlanish.

tasks.en: Whoopi Goldberg doesn't worry about how healthy her diet is, and loves fatty bacon sandwiches with lettuce, mayonnaise and lots of butter.
tasks.uz: Vupi Goldberg ovqatlanishi qanchalik sog'lomligidan xavotir olmaydi va salat bargi, mayonez va ko'p sariyog' bilan yog'li bekonli sendvichlarni yaxshi ko'radi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to worry ABOUT' - 'about' predlogi.
⚠ 'butter' - SANALMAYDIGAN → 'LOTS OF butter'.

tasks.en: One thing for sure is that cooking for the stars is never easy, because they are often fussy eaters.
tasks.uz: Aniq bir narsa: yulduzlarga ovqat pishirish hech qachon oson emas, chunki ular ko'pincha injiq yeguvchilar.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'for sure' = aniq.
⚠ 'to cook FOR sb' - 'for' predlogi.
⚠ 'a fussy eater' - 40-betda ham bor edi.

tasks.en: "They want food fixed exactly the way they like it and always have something to complain about," says caterer Susan Tate.
tasks.uz: "Ular ovqat aynan o'zlari xohlagandek tayyorlanishini istaydi va doim shikoyat qiladigan narsa topadi", - deydi ta'minotchi Syuzan Teyt.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'fixed' bu yerda = tayyorlangan (AQSh usuli).
⚠ 'to complain ABOUT' - 'about' predlogi.
⚠ 'the way they like it' = o'zlari xohlagandek.

tasks.en: Bill Murray won't eat watermelon with seeds in it, and Mickey Rourke insists on freshly-squeezed carrot juice twice a day, but he won't drink it if it sits for more than six minutes.
tasks.uz: Bill Marrey urug'li tarvuzni yemaydi, Mikki Rurk esa kuniga ikki marta yangi siqilgan sabzi sharbatini talab qiladi, lekin agar u olti daqiqadan ortiq tursa, ichmaydi.
tasks.note:
⚠ "won't" bu yerda = QAT'IY rad etish
('will' ning bu ma'nosi ham bor).
⚠ 'to sit' bu yerda = turmoq, qolmoq.

tasks.en: Cooking for the stars is hard work, but few of these caterers ever think about changing jobs. "I love my work," says Susan Tate.
tasks.uz: Yulduzlarga ovqat pishirish - og'ir mehnat, lekin bu ta'minotchilarning ozchiligi ish almashtirish haqida o'ylaydi. "Men ishimni yaxshi ko'raman", - deydi Syuzan Teyt.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'FEW' (artiklsiz) = juda oz (salbiy ma'no).
⚠ 'A few' = bir nechta (ijobiy).
⚠ 'to think ABOUT' + -ING.

tasks.en: "Where else can I see what Michelle Pfeiffer eats for breakfast or what Al Pacino has for a snack?"
tasks.uz: "Michelle Pfeiffer nonushtaga nima yeyishini yoki Al Pachino tamaddiga nima olishini yana qayerda ko'ra olaman?"
tasks.note:
⚠ 'for breakfast' - ARTIKLSIZ.
⚠ 'for A snack' - artikl BOR.
⚠ 'to have sth for a snack' = tamaddiga
nimadir olmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Which of the words in the list go with: a; an; some? Which are countable? Which are uncountable?
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi qaysi so'zlar a; an; some bilan keladi? Qaysilari sanaladigan? Qaysilari sanalmaydigan?
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh GURUH.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  'A' + SANALADIGAN BIRLIK        ║
║  (undosh tovush)                 ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  a hamburger, a banana,
  a jacket potato, a hot dog,
  a biscuit, a peach


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  'AN' + SANALADIGAN BIRLIK       ║
║  (unli tovush)                   ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  an apple, an apricot


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  'SOME' + KO'PLIK yoki           ║
║  SANALMAYDIGAN                   ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  KO'PLIK (sanaladigan):
     some sweets, some chips,
     some chocolates, some eggs,
     some grapes

  SANALMAYDIGAN:
     some pasta, some orange juice,
     some tea, some coffee,
     some milk, some bacon


⚠ ENG MUHIM QOIDA:

  SANALADIGAN → 'a/an' (birlikda),
     '-s' (ko'plikda)
  SANALMAYDIGAN → 'a/an' YO'Q,
     '-s' YO'Q, 'some' bilan

  ⚠ 'a milk' - XATO!
  ⚠ 'milks' - XATO!
  ⚠ 'some milk' ✓


⚠ 'A' yoki 'AN'?

  ⚠ TOVUShga qarab, HARFga emas!
     an Apple (a - unli)
     an Apricot (a - unli)
     a Hamburger (h - undosh)
     a Hot dog (h - undosh)

  ⚠ 'a Uniform' - 'u' /juː/ deb
  o'qilgani uchun 'a' (35-betda
  ham bor edi).


⚠ 'PASTA' - SANALMAYDIGAN:

  ⚠ 'a pasta' - XATO.
  ⚠ 'a plate of pasta' ✓


⚠ 'GRAPES' - HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA:

  ⚠ 'a grape' bitta uzum donasi -
  kam ishlatiladi.
  ⚠ 'some grapes' = bir bosh uzum.


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: Would you like SOME BACON?
  SB: Yes, please. And can I have
      SOME CHIPS, too?
  SA: Of course. Do you want A PEACH?
  SB: No, thanks. I'd rather have
      AN APPLE.


⚠ "I'D RATHER HAVE ...":

  = ... ni afzal ko'raman.
  ⚠ "I'd rather" = 'I would rather'.
  ⚠ Keyin 'to' SIZ fe'l:
  "I'd rather HAVE" ✓
  "I'd rather to have" - XATO!

TO'LIQ DIALOG:

  A: Have we got what we need for

     1) SOME burgers, but there
     aren't 2) ANY rolls at all.
  A: How 3) MANY rolls do you need?
  B: Just 4) A FEW. I need 5) SOME
     cheese, too.
  A: How 6) MUCH cheese is there in
     the fridge?
  B: Not 7) MUCH, but I only need
     8) A LITTLE.
  A: Is there 9) ANY ketchup left?
  B: Only 10) A LITTLE, but we don't
     need much, so don't buy 11) ANY.
     We haven't got 12) ANY mustard
     at all, though.
  A: I'll buy 13) SOME, then.


⚠ HAR BANDNING SABABI:

  1 TASDIQ + ko'plik → some
  2 INKOR + ko'plik → any
  3 SAVOL + SANALADIGAN → many
  4 sanaladigan, 'bir nechta' →
    a few
  5 TASDIQ + sanalmaydigan → some
  6 SAVOL + SANALMAYDIGAN → much
  7 INKOR + sanalmaydigan → much
  8 sanalmaydigan, 'biroz' →

  9 SAVOL + sanalmaydigan → any
  10 sanalmaydigan, 'biroz' →
     a little
  11 INKOR (buyruq) → any

  13 TASDIQ → some
